prompt: A warm painted animated film in the same elegant olive-green restaurant kitchen. One continuous locked-off medium shot. Preserve the characters, faces, adult proportions, clothing, warm lighting, painted texture and fixed kitchen from the reference. Natural restrained human motion at normal speed. Stable solid objects with clearly separated hands and surfaces. The chef already holds a single pear securely in one hand. She carries that same pear across the clear air above the wooden bench to the preparation basket on her right. She lowers the pear into the open basket, releases it only when it rests on the folded cloth inside the empty basket, then withdraws her empty hand above the basket rim. Her fingers keep a stable grip during the transfer. Both baskets remain fixed on the bench.
